name: vscode-cacl
description: Syntax highlighting and Language Server Protocol (LSP) support for CFMS Access Control Language (CACL / CEP 2).

cacl.server.command.description: Path or executable name of the cacl-lsp server. Leave empty to auto-detect from workspace .venv, PATH, or `uv run cacl-lsp`.

cacl.server.args.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to cacl-lsp (e.g. ["--log-level", "DEBUG"]).

cacl.server.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the CACL language server.

cacl.compiler.targetObjectType.description: Optional target object type context for deeper scope-applicability diagnostics (W205).

cacl.format.preserveComments.description: Preserve leading, inline, and trailing `#` comments when formatting CACL documents.

cacl.format.foldPresets.description: Greedily fold exact atomic operation subsets back into CEP 2 preset macros when formatting.

cacl.format.preferToSyntax.description: Render positive principal-only disjunctions using `to ...` shorthand instead of `when ...`.

cacl.format.omitDefaultScope.description: Omit the implicit default `on all` scope clause when formatting.

cacl.format.alwaysEmitInherit.description: Always emit an explicit `inherit on;` / `inherit off;` directive when formatting.

cacl.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inline hints for resolved macro/subtraction bitmasks, implicit `on all` scopes, and expired rules.
